content: {"phoneNote":"Phone first screen stacks three call actions (header Pokličite, Pokličite me, and the fixed bar) and two directions links, leaving the hero links as plain underlined text that reads weaker than the header button.","desktopNote":"Desktop hero works, but the footer's giant two-line wordmark swallows a whole screen and the Kje delam band is a near-empty grey strip with two words.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":3},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":2,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":3},"fixes":["Remove the duplicate Pokličite/Navodila za pot pair from the header (the fixed bar and hero already carry them) and style the hero's Pokličite me as the single solid primary button.","Shrink the footer wordmark to a normal heading and merge the thin Kje delam strip into the contact band to kill the dead grey gaps on desktop.","Merge the Kopije ključev section and the dark Ključe kopiram v delavnici CTA, which say the same thing twice; use the saved space for the Delovni čas/24h emergency note near the hero."],"blockers":["Phone and desktop: workshop key-copying is stated three times (services list, Kopije ključev section, dark CTA band) with the same Pot do delavnice link repeated.","Desktop footer: oversized two-line wordmark fills most of a screen and dwarfs the contact details beneath it."]}
